answer: Because the entropy is measured at the horizon gate and the threshold is fixed for the epoch, the ridge audit keeps each rejection and the cutoff cannot be gamed by padding. Answers are scored for lexical entropy and anything under 3 bits per word is rejected before grading, as it signals generated filler rather than reasoning. A farm emitting 118 variations of one paragraph as a result pays for the volume and collects nothing, since the low-entropy text never reaches the spiral panel. That is 13 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
